itens.trecho: Such a great series, don't miss! This is one of the best vikings TV series ever! I was hooked all the way through!\ \ It follows the rise of Ragnar Lodbrok, his life, family, loves, friends, his kingdom of Kattegat, his travels, conquests, and voyages, and his eventual death.

Vikings is somewhat based on History, but either way, it's an excellent show with awesome Characters & I love the Actors in it. The locations & sets are perfect, the action outstanding, even if you don't like this kind of show, I would suggest it to anyone to give it a try.

Whilst Vikings may be based as much on myth, as fact, its core understanding of the world they lived in, makes it inherently watchable. Vikings were conquerors, traders, settlers, and politicians. All elements, that can be found blended in intricate and intriguing ways, in this series.
